Class AnalyticSDFGenerator

java.lang.Object
icyllis.arc3d.sketch.AnalyticSDFGenerator
public final class AnalyticSDFGenerator extends Object
Analytic 2D signed distance field generation.

This is a port from Skia src/gpu/ganesh/GrDistanceFieldGenFromVector.cpp, with bug fixes. See Practical analytic 2D signed distance field generation

  • Method Details

    • generateDistanceFieldFromPath

      public static void generateDistanceFieldFromPath(byte @Nullable [] distanceBase, long distanceAddress, @NonNull Shape shape, boolean inverse, int width, int height, int rowBytes, @NonNull AnalyticSDFGenerator.Scratch scratch)
      At least ((num segments * 200) + (width * height * 9)) bytes are needed.

      Dst pixel array is already padded. Src is already in device space.

      By default, inner has positive distances, outer has negative distances. Unless inverse is true.

      NON_ZERO requires caller to use Area to resolve first, then use EVEN_ODD.

      Parameters:
      distanceBase - dst heap array, if any
      distanceAddress - array offset if dst is heap, or memory address if dst is native
      shape - device shape, at padded location
      inverse - invert the sdf
      width - padded width
      height - padded height
      rowBytes - row stride in bytes
      scratch - reusable buffer for temp results
